CheckTitle: RDS instance has SSL encryption enabled
Description: **Huawei Cloud Relational Database Service (RDS)** instances have **SSL/TLS encryption** enabled to protect data in transit between clients and the database.
Risk: Without **SSL encryption**, database traffic—including credentials and sensitive query results—can be intercepted or tampered with over the network.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Relational Database Service (RDS)** > **Instances**.
3. Click the target DB instance.
4. On the **Basic Information** page, enable **SSL**.
5. Download the CA certificate and update client connection strings.

Recommendation.Text: Enable **SSL** on all RDS instances and require encrypted connections from database clients.
